role: C04 bounded individual contextual source review
decision: The patch removes CDK_TABLE_TEMPLATE, CanStick and sticky-styler exports, inlines the CDK table template and deletes a modern Material comment. Material 16 legacy table used CDK_TABLE_TEMPLATE; the current owned legacy table instead supplies its own caption, column, native/flex and server template and the owned outlet bridge. Do not reintroduce the removed template or sticky internals as peer imports. This decision does not qualify inherited CdkTable rendering or its private outlet hooks. The authorized November 8 table exception covers only the enumerated outlet bridge hooks and requires peer-bound lifecycle, nested, native/flex and no-data testing. Packed AOT, caption/colgroup projection, outlet ownership, server and hydration behavior remain open.
